sloka: अद्य राक्षसराजस्य भयमुत्पाटयाम्यहम् ।पातयिष्ये महेन्द्रं वा शातयिष्ये तथा ऽनलम् ।। ६.६०.७० ।।।।
transliteration: adya rākṣasarājasya bhayamutpāṭayāmyaham ।pātayiṣye mahendraṁ vā śātayiṣye tathā 'nalam ।। 6.60.70 ।।।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna, tamer of enemies having spoken in that way in anger, Yupaksha, a minister joined palms and replied to him.
